thread:
elaine (Partnerships): Heads up: DeltaWeights is asking to list their quantized families on AWS Marketplace and Azure EU, plus a co-branded SI bundle with EdgeSI. Need to lock commercial flow, geo-blocking, and announcement timing before we proceed.
mike_p (PM): Do they want Redwood-hosted endpoints plus marketplace resale, or to allow distribution of model artifacts so marketplaces can host copies?
sanjay (Legal): They signed our openweights template but attached a commercial addendum. Major flags: they want strict geo-restrictions for some APAC territories, revenue split ambiguity, and a prohibition on sublicensing raw weights.
edgeSI-rep: EdgeSI wants a 60-day APAC exclusivity on joint announcement and a co-branding kit. They also suggested an integration uplift fee (10%).
tara (BizDev): DeltaWeights proposed 70/30 hosted revenue split. Marketplaces usually push to 85/15. We need a harmonized approach or separate paths.
elaine (Partnerships): Suggestion: dual-path commercial terms: (A) Redwood-hosted access at 70/30, (B) marketplace-listed SKU under marketplace commercial terms (e.g., 85/15) with an addendum and monthly proof-of-use reporting + clawback. Agreeable?
sanjay (Legal): Workable if we require provenance metadata (model_hash, training_dataset_origin, quant_profile) and explicit invoicing flow: marketplace -> Redwood -> provider, with 30-day settlement. Also require export-control warranty and an explicit non-sublicense clause.
legal-bot: quick stat: deltaweights_addendum.pdf missing "geo-blocking" language. ACTION: request provider add geo-block clause and clarify territories.
mike_p (PM): Implementation notes: catalog needs to surface SKU types: "hosted" vs "marketplace" with an entitlement flag so Dedicated/Private customers can't accidentally select marketplace-only variants. I'll open RD-OPS-8799 for entitlements + routing. ETA ~2 weeks for backend + basic UI.
tara (BizDev): On exclusivity: EdgeSI's 60-day APAC window could block other partners. We should accept only if DeltaWeights funds exclusive co-marketing and we cap exclusivity to channel announcement (no product-level lock).
jess (Marketing): 60 days is okay if DeltaWeights funds co-marketing. Require joint PR draft 10 days prior, embargo aligned with AWS/Azure listing and Redwood console rollout. Need logo, trademark sign-off, and partner one-pager by T-7.
elaine (Partnerships): Next steps: (1) Tara to renegotiate marketplace split and SI uplift; push towards 80/20 marketplace baseline and 12% SI fee; (2) Sanjay to request revised addendum with geo-block list, non-sublicense language, and export warranty; (3) Mike to implement SKU entitlement flag and routing; (4) Jess to prep co-marketing checklist and timeline.
tara (BizDev): I'll push for 80/20 and a 12% SI uplift. Will share negotiation notes in this thread.
sanjay (Legal): Drafting addendum request. Including clause: "No sublicensing of raw model weights to third-party resellers without written consent." Also adding manifest metadata requirement and export-control representation. Sending to DeltaWeights legal now.
mike_p (PM): RD-OPS-8799 created: fields planned: marketplace_available (bool), marketplace_variant_id (string), entitlement_flags (list). Tests to ensure Dedicated clusters prefer hosted SKUs. Assigning to infra team.
elaine (Partnerships): Thanks team. I'll coordinate with DeltaWeights and EdgeSI and update once we get the revised addendum and co-marketing commitment. Please update by EOD Thu. :thumbsup:
